description: REQ-W1 + EDGE-E5 (picked=None) and the skip guard (dormant/unfixable/MINIMAL) paths are not exercised by any test. test_dispatch_integration_roi.py only asserts the happy-path row shape (test_dispatch_appends_exactly_one_roi_row) and byte-identical preservation (test_dispatch_preserves_existing_roi_rows) — both of which drive the dispatcher through the pick_next success branch. There is no test that: (a) forces budget=MINIMAL with tasks_pending=0 and asserts the tick behaviour w.r.t. roi.jsonl; (b) pre-creates .dormant.sentinel and asserts behaviour; (c) supplies a menu that yields picked=None (all categories blocked) and asserts behaviour; (d) pre-creates >=3 rows in .unfixable.jsonl and asserts behaviour. The absence of these tests is what allowed the FIND-001 REQ-W1 gap to slip through — the current test suite would still PASS even though the ROI writer silently drops every non-happy tick. This is the classic 'tests assert only what the code happens to do' failure mode: green suite, unmet contract.
